title: Universal KB Observation Envelope — v2
description: Public schema for observations. Wrappers (kb-write-observation.sh) enforce these constraints. An observation attaches a verbatim transcript-grounded fact to an existing entity.

entity_type.description: Type of the entity this observation attaches to. Must match one of the types in entity-types.json.

entity_name.description: canonical_name of the target entity. Wrapper does NOT verify the entity exists in the graph (write-side validation). Caller is responsible for entity-first ordering.

observation.description: Factual statement about the entity. Present tense, grounded, no speculation.

evidence_snippet.description: Verbatim quote (≥20 chars) from the source transcript that justifies the observation. Provenance gate — wrapper rejects shorter snippets. Should be findable via grep/rg in the raw transcript.

source_session_id.description: Session that produced this observation. Pairs with KB_SESSION_ID env. Used for surgical rollback via /athanor trace.

_runtime_enrichment.description: Wrapper enriches the staged record with these fields after validation. They are NOT user-provided.

good.observation: useEffect runs twice in development under React 18 StrictMode by design
good.evidence_snippet: StrictMode intentionally double-invokes effects in dev to surface missing cleanup; production runs once
